name: SearchLink Lite
tagline: Read-only Google Search Console for Cline
description: Local, read-only MCP server for Google Search Console. Site overview with period comparison, search performance by query, page, country, device or date, low-CTR and position 8-20 opportunities, URL inspection, sitemap status, on-page checks and Google ranking update history. Totals come from the date dimension, so they match the Search Console UI.

env.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
env.description: Path to a Google service account key file or gcloud application default credentials that can read your Search Console. Needed for the Search Console tools; page_check and algorithm_updates work without it.
